R10.reason: The bottom and center rail positions are not stated in the step, and the viewed image shows none. They can be worked out only by arithmetic from the optional leg-groove steps: bottom rail top = 4-1/4 + 3/4 = 5" from the bottom; center rail bottom = 4-1/4 + 10 − 3/4 = 13-1/2". A builder who skips the optional grooves (steps[3] '(Optional)') has no stated position.
